checkpoint.feature_policy: ESM-only adapted on disease-independent TUnA partitions

inference.symmetric: evaluate A-B and B-A and average corresponding logits before sigmoid
inference.primary_long_sequence_policy: use residues 1..max_pair_len, matching the frozen training loader, and export truncation flags
inference.long_sequence_sensitivity: separately preregistered multi-window analysis; it cannot replace primary checkpoint-native inference

native_outputs.scalar: p_PPI, L1/L2/L3 logits and probabilities, T-MEB gates and contributions, reliability, order gaps
native_outputs.compact_evidence: L1 residue profiles, L2-to-L1 projections, Top-K residues, Top-M interfaces, z_L1/z_L2/z_L3
native_outputs.dense_interface: not stored for every pair; exactly regenerable from checkpoint, registry row and ESM inputs

diagnostic_innovations.tri_level_consensus_diagnostic: normalized agreement among p_L1, p_L2 and p_L3
diagnostic_innovations.T_MEB_gate_entropy_normalized: how broadly T-MEB distributes reliance across L1/L2/L3
diagnostic_innovations.order_stability_diagnostic: stability of A-B versus B-A fused probabilities
diagnostic_innovations.L1_L2_projection_correlation: agreement between L1 residue probabilities and residue projections of L2 interface logits
diagnostic_innovations.cross_level_coherence_diagnostic: product diagnostic combining level agreement, low contribution conflict and order stability
diagnostic_innovations.interpretation: model-internal evidence geometry only; not biological causality or uncertainty calibration

next_stage: audit frozen primary p_PPI outputs, then construct r_OSA separately
